## Checklist

- [ ] Scope is focused — one logical change per PR
- [ ] Tests added or updated for every behavioral change
- [ ] `ruff check .` passes
- [ ] `python -m build` succeeds
- [ ] `python -m twine check dist/*` passes
- [ ] No real credentials or API keys included
- [ ] No copyrighted subtitle material in tests or samples
- [ ] Provider-neutral core preserved (no provider SDK imports in core modules)
- [ ] Documentation updated for user-visible changes
- [ ] CHANGELOG entry added under `[Unreleased]` for user-visible changes
- [ ] No real API calls in automated tests
